The main takeaway from our work is that

we need to move away from thinking about biological systems as ‘molecular machines’ and towards thinking about them as ‘molecular ecosystems’, which can be understood by considering their large-scale physical properties.
morphogenetic properties are not necessarily encoded in the molecular composition but can emerge from a variety of molecular mechanisms.
